purpose: Prevent malformed numeric inputs and surplus CSV cells from silently changing energy or elapsed time.
methods: Freeze tests and evaluator before runtime edits; exercise same generated synthetic files via real CLI before/after; test inline, JSON, CSV and ESPI adapters; actual SDK error and recovery in both existing modes; complete necessary regression at milestone.
preserve: rate and assistance snapshots and dates
acceptance: Every invalid case returns its domain error without parsed values; every valid control retains its value and duration. No dropped CSV cells. Existing tests remain unchanged.
